seoTitle: Pivot Table Builder for CSV: Sum, Count, Average
metaDescription: Summarise a CSV as a cross-tab by typing the row, column and value fields and sum, count, average, min or max. Free, no upload.
intro: Builds a pivot table from a CSV: choose the row field, an optional column field and the value to summarise.
why:
A pivot answers questions like revenue by region and product in one table. Instead of dragging fields, you type their names, which works with a keyboard and is easy to repeat.

Values that are not numbers are skipped and counted, except with count. Totals are added for rows and columns; averages in the total cells are averages of all values, not of the cells shown. For several measures run the tool once per measure.
howTo: Paste the CSV with a header.
Type the row field, column field (optional) and the value field.
Choose sum, count, average, min or max.
Copy or download the pivot as CSV.

faq.q: Can I use two row fields?
faq.a: Not yet. Merge the two columns first with the column merger.
Combinations with no rows are left empty.
No. They are computed over all underlying values.
It is held in memory; tens of thousands of rows are fine.
